name: Session Harness and Determinism Plumbing
area: Owns harness_session, seed sweep, run path, determinism controls, and session-export auditability bugs.
audit_basis: Matched queued BUG IDs against regression tests in tests/test_bug*.py.
Included previously merged no-op or patch-only lineage already applied in this workspace thread for BUG-013, BUG-124, BUG-135, and BUG-138.

items.title: Session harness does not exercise PROBE and simulated learner ignores context
`harness_session` ignores env-backed protocol and grounding paths
Mirror enablement and privacy controls are not propagated or auditable across session tooling
`seed_sweep.py` run identity is predictably tied to `--seed`, not to the actual sweep workload
`run_paths.py` resolves default and relative runs roots against the caller's current working directory
Session artifacts misreport the learner state that actually drove tutoring, and the `flow` vs `frustrated` stub-tutor branch is behaviorally dead in exported output
